questionFormObservations.microPurposeCandidate: Select a diagram scale and horizontal/vertical offsets to compare oblique segment lengths; distinguish useful measurement information from decorative contours.
questionFormObservations.practicalStrategyCandidate: Compare squared segment lengths when only ordering is needed; do not guess from an outline or round too early.

questionFormObservations.microPurposeCandidate: Separate removed external faces from newly exposed faces, then express the net surface change algebraically.
questionFormObservations.practicalStrategyCandidate: Track lost and gained surfaces separately before simplifying; a removed solid does not automatically remove all its face area from the external surface.
